item.title: Profiling
item.description: Profiling is the process of measuring the performance of your application to identify bottlenecks and optimize resource usage. In this section, we will explore Langium’s profiling tools and techniques that can help you analyze the performance of your parsing process. item.title: Caches
item.description: What is the problem? You have parsed a document and you would like to execute some computation on the AST. But you don’t want to do this every time you see a certain node. You want to do it once for the lifetime of a document. Where to save it? How to solve it?
